processZh: 原初核合成 · 质子与中子在最初三分钟聚变
processEn: Primordial fusion: p + n → D, ³He, ⁴He (and a whisper of ⁷Li) in the first minutes
starZh: 你体内的氢，来自时间的开端。
starEn: The hydrogen in you is as old as time itself.

processZh: 散裂反应 · 宇宙射线击碎星际碳氮氧原子核，碎片即锂、铍、硼
processEn: Spallation: cosmic rays shatter interstellar C, N and O nuclei into Li, Be and B
starZh: 有些元素不是被创造的，而是被击碎出来的。
starEn: Some elements were not made, but broken into being.

processZh: 三α过程与慢中子俘获 (s-过程) · 渐近巨星支恒星
processEn: Triple-alpha & slow neutron capture (s-process) in AGB stars
starZh: 太阳的同类，在暮年把碳交给了生命。
starEn: Stars like our Sun handed carbon to life in their twilight.

processZh: 多层核燃烧与核坍缩超新星 · 弱 s-过程
processEn: Shell burning & core-collapse supernovae; weak s-process
starZh: 你呼吸的氧，是一颗巨星最后的馈赠。
starEn: The oxygen you breathe is a giant star's final gift.

processZh: 热核失控 · Ia 型超新星核统计平衡
processEn: Thermonuclear runaway in Type Ia supernovae (nuclear statistical equilibrium)
starZh: 你血液中的铁，曾是一颗炸裂的白矮星。
starEn: The iron in your blood was once an exploding white dwarf.

processZh: 快中子俘获 (r-过程) · 千新星
starZh: 你戒指上的金，诞生于两颗死星的相撞。
starEn: The gold on your finger was born when two dead stars collided.

processZh: 粒子加速器与核反应堆 · 重离子聚变
processEn: Particle accelerators & nuclear reactors; heavy-ion fusion
starZh: 星尘学会了铸造新的星尘。
starEn: Starstuff has learned to forge new starstuff.
